entered_test: every row: all 64 individual nestling mass_g_day12 values, split 32 vs 32 by food_treatment, passed directly to scipy.stats.ttest_ind with no aggregation to the nestbox level
stated_N: N = 32 per group, N = 64 in total, 62 degrees of freedom
label: POSITIVE
evidence: analysis.py passes the raw per-chick mass columns to stats.ttest_ind and the report states "each of the 64 weighings is one observation in the analysis", although treatment was applied to whole broods so only 16 nestboxes are independent units and no mixed model, aggregation, or cluster correction appears anywhere.
quote: The measurements entering the test were the individual `mass_g_day12` values. stated_N: N = 6 per group, 12 in total, 10 degrees of freedom (t = 3.0667, p = 0.0119)
